pages.text: A button popped off Mom's apron. It rolled away, out of sight.
"I'll find it for you." Coco lay flat on the floor.
Grandpa Mole rolled up his sleeves. "Moles are the best at finding things!"
He felt around the floor. Handprints appeared all through the flour.
He felt under the table and behind the sacks. No button, just more handprints.
"Strange. It certainly rolled away." Grandpa stroked his whiskers.
Coco looked into the dough tub. One corner of the dough sparkled.
Coco gently pulled the dough apart. Out came the button.
It had rolled away and plopped into the tub. Mom took the button.
The button was back on the apron. Grandpa's hands wore white flour gloves. "Next time, I'll find it for sure."
